1
Tu Maan Mera Ghazi Tak Haal Mera Ghazi.
Main Baaj Rida Roni Aan Sun Meri Sada Ghazi.
Fojaan Aayiyaan Aan Ke Khaimay Sarey.
Mere Putar Bhira Mar Dittay Ne Sare.
Main Balaan Nu Labni Aan Kenday Ne Bola Ghazi.
Bharjaiyaan Ne Naal Mere Dhiyaan Ne.
Rasiyaan Tanay Maraan V Sehyaan Ne.
Bheraan Wich Khaloni Aan Naa Lainday Mera Ghazi.
Zakhmi Sir Ne Nezay Marday Ray Ne.
Lut Chadraan Lo Narey Marday Ray Ne.
Mitiyaan Sir Te Pani Aan Le Gayi Aye Rida Ghazi.
Masooma De Bha Lag Gayi Kurtay Nu.
Na Kool Aawein Na Hath La Burqay Nu.
Kaindi Main Syedani Aan Chacha Aye Mera Ghazi.
Kuj Zulm Likhe:AAL E ABDULLAH: Ne.
Imam Bachay Janda Bas ALLAH Aye.
Kinj Abid Bachani Aan Ban Gayi Aan Bhira Ghazi.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/tu-maan-mera-ghazi-tak-haal-mera-ghazi-lyrics-in-punjabi-2023-tajpoints-b09c69e414c8e4f661aa.md')
s = p.read_text()
_, meta, body = s.split('---')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert roman[0] == '  1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert len(roman) == len(source) == 18
assert all(line.startswith('  ') and not line.endswith('.') for line in roman)
assert all(any('\\u0600' <= c <= '\\u06ff' for c in line) for line in source)
assert '\\u200c' not in s
print('Verified 17 aligned verse lines in one numbered stanza.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Panjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions contain one numbered stanza with 17 verse lines. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected file was edited.

I read *sarey* in the tent verse as ساڑے (“burned”) and *tanay* as طعنے (“taunts”).
